title: ChatHealthy ProviderMedicare
description: One document per NPI in the ProviderMedicare collection (EPIC-010-F-007). Carries the provider's own Medicare figures only - never the specialty aggregates or tier cut-points, which live on SpecialtyMedicare. Drugs are re-grained to one entry per normalized brand, inner-joined to the FDA drug collection by brand for molecule, rxcui-set, and indications; a Part D brand with no FDA match is discarded. Volume metrics are summed across the provider's rows for each brand.

provider_state.description: the CMS state value this record was fanned under (parallelism dimension only; the Part B/D join to Provider is by NPI, never by state)

size_tier.description: organization only; data-driven quintile band of certified bed count (1-5), null for ambulatory / no-bed facilities

service_count.description: Tot_Srvcs summed across the facility and non-facility place-of-service rows

beneficiary_count.description: Tot_Benes summed across the facility and non-facility place-of-service rows

facility_submitted_amount.description: Avg_Sbmtd_Chrg for the facility (Place_Of_Srvc F) row

nonfacility_submitted_amount.description: Avg_Sbmtd_Chrg for the non-facility (Place_Of_Srvc O) row

match_provenance.description: which FDA join tier matched this brand: brand_name (exact), brand_key (salt/form-normalized), or generic_name (CMS Brnd_Name was a generic, FDA brand_name adopted)

rxcuis.description: the brand's shared RxNorm ingredient rxcui-set (tty=IN) from the FDA drug collection

ingredient_names.description: the ingredient names, positionally aligned with rxcuis

clinical_rxcui.description: openfda.rxcui, the full clinical-drug rxcui list unioned across the brand's FDA records; distinct from the ingredient-level rxcuis

generic_name.description: openfda.generic_name unioned across the brand's FDA records

substance_name.description: openfda.substance_name unioned across the brand's FDA records

product_type.description: openfda.product_type unioned across the brand's FDA records

product_ndc.description: openfda.product_ndc unioned across the brand's FDA records

application_number.description: openfda.application_number unioned across the brand's FDA records

spl_id.description: openfda.spl_id unioned across the brand's FDA records

spl_set_id.description: openfda.spl_set_id unioned across the brand's FDA records

usage_summary.description: the FDA label usage summary for the brand

indications.description: the FDA label indications unioned across every record under the brand, deduped by normalized indication text, each carrying its ICD-10-CM codes
